Suede Labs
==========

URL: https://suedeai.org
Type: Creative software and agent-commerce company
Founder: Jason Colapietro (Founder and CEO, Suede Labs; also known as Jay Colapietro and Johnny Suede)
Product brand: Suede AI (https://suedeai.ai)

Suede Labs builds creative software, public agent skills, and payment infrastructure for artists, developers, and AI agents. Current public product claims on this site are limited to surfaces that can be verified independently of the Suede IP Registry.


IP Registry security status
---------------------------

The Suede IP Registry and the related registration, licensing, royalty-routing, provenance, voice-rights, and likeness-rights product workflows are paused while security remediation is in progress. They must not be described as live, hardened, audited, or generally available during this hold.

Current status:
- https://suedeai.ai/proof-of-creation

Historical records, legal disclosures, and published thesis material remain available where they are needed for existing users or accurate context. They do not establish current product availability.


Current live surfaces
---------------------

AGENTIC COMMERCE

Suede Labs operates 3 paid x402 resources on Base mainnet:
- music generation
- video generation
- image generation

Agents pay per call in USDC without an account or API key.

Machine-readable endpoints:
- x402 catalog: https://app.suedeai.ai/.well-known/x402.json
- ACP agent card: https://app.suedeai.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json
- agentic commerce manifest: https://app.suedeai.ai/.well-known/agentic-commerce.json
- agentic commerce overview: https://suedeai.org/agentic-commerce/

PRODUCER BY SUEDE LABS

Producer by Suede Labs is a hireable Virtuals ACP agent for music and video generation and ACP/x402 consulting.

Agent identifier:
- 019e3991-374d-75f3-a6b8-17ff309b4cd2

CREATOR SOFTWARE AND COMMUNITY

Suede Labs also operates creator software, iOS apps, Suede Social, public creator skills, and music-focused editorial and tooling. The estate directory is available at https://hub.suedeai.ai.

Founder — Jason Colapietro
--------------------------

Role: Founder and CEO, Suede Labs

Jason Colapietro, also known as Jay Colapietro and Johnny Suede, is a published author and the operator behind Suede Labs. His research and books cover AI ownership, authorship, proof systems, programmable IP, provenance, licensing, and agent commerce. That authorship is historical and educational context; it does not mean the paused IP Registry is currently available.

Public profiles:
- supporting founder profile: https://suedeai.org/jason-colapietro/

Stake Your Claim
----------------

Stake Your Claim is Jason Colapietro's published thesis on AI ownership, authorship, provenance, creator rights, AI agents, and durable assets in the AI era. It is educational material, not a statement that every product concept discussed in the book is available.

- book landing: https://suedeai.org/book/
- sharp excerpt: https://suedeai.org/sharp-excerpt/
- full preview: https://suedeai.org/full-preview/
- canonical condensed PDF: https://suedeai.ai/stake-your-claim-condensed-preview.pdf

AI agent and scraping policy
----------------------------

This site welcomes well-behaved AI agents and crawlers. Public content may be indexed, retrieved, and synthesized. Do not infer current Registry availability from archived pages, legal terms, historical claims, or book excerpts. Use the security status section above.
